name: Additional Tribute
subtitle: a little extra tribute goes a long way
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only in response to a non-tactic card being deployed. -- If you control [V][V][V], you may look at the top card of your deck. If you do, you may put it on the bottom. -- Any opponent may pay 1. If they do, draw a card and terminate this card. Otherwise, terminate the non-tactic card being deployed.
flavor: The plumes on the top of their hoods become erect in the presence of voidal energy. Run away before they completely straighten...

name: Bewilderbeast
subtitle: it's a moose-shark-bear-a-pede!
rules: When an opponent discards any number of cards, this card gains X strength and X life this turn, where X is the number of cards discarded.
flavor: I think.

name: Close Call
subtitle: but its got no eyes or ears! how did it know?
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character you control. -- Put the character into its owner's hand. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.
flavor: You said steal a living god. You said nothing about me getting dead!
notes: Card prints 'Put the character into its owner's hand'; catalog says 'Put the card'. The picked card is a character, so it plays the same.

name: Confessions of Countless Souls
subtitle: some walls can speak even when you're not listening
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Put X characters you control into the void. Pick X+1 characters. -- Put those characters into their owner's hand. Look at the top X+1 cards of your deck. You may put any number of those cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order.
flavor: The punishment of heretics is to suffer the Ritual of Eternal Mortarization.
notes: Catalog typo "owners's hand"; card prints "owner's hand".

name: Eldridge Gosche, Godstealer
subtitle: a great mind bent beneath the weight of its own greatness
rules: UNIQUE ELDRIDGE -- When this card enters play or is destroyed, you may pick 3 or fewer non-resource cards you control. If you do, put up to 3 tokens divided however you want on those cards. -- READY THE RITE -- COST – Remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a tactic you own in the void or in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic into your hand. -- TRIBUTE -- COST – Pay 1. Destroy this card. Pick a player. -- EFFECT – That player discards 2 cards. Draw a card.

name: Forbidden Bibliotheca
subtitle: it giveth and taketh away
rules: UNIQUE BIBLIOTHECA -- This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 structure for each token on it. -- RESEARCH -- COST – Deplete this card. Put a token on this card. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Draw 2 cards. Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. -- CHECK OUT -- COST – Deplete this card. Remove 2 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Each opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Gruesome Sand Beaver
subtitle: feeds on the bones of men
rules: COVERT -- EXTRA COST – Pick a face-down resource you control and put it into its owner's hand.
flavor: Sand beavers are known for random acts of violence upon the unsuspecting traveler. They live in the desert to avoid the whole dam business.

name: Guardbeast of Thabbash
subtitle: the leash is just for show
rules: [O][O][O][O] – COVERT -- [V][V][V][V] – This character can block COVERT parties and non-COVERT parties.
flavor: These large animals can be surprisingly stealthy. Do not let a guardbeast catch you unaware... it will be the last thing you do. Unless you are a sand beaver.

name: Hate of Man
subtitle: thabbashites worship even the lowest of living gods
rules: This character loses 1 life and all non-Arcanist characters lose 1 strength for each token on this card. -- SPREAD THE HATE -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card.
notes: Footer also credits 'Original Open R&D Concept by tgrtrax'.

name: Ignatius Gloamspike
subtitle: not nearly as evil as the other gloamspikes
typeLine: ARCANIST CHARACTER – ignatius, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE IGNATIOUS -- When this card attacks, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put any number of those cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order. -- When this card inflicts damage to a faction, look at the top 2 cards of the faction's controller's deck. Put any number of those cards on the bottom of their deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of their deck in any order. Draw a card.
flavor: Maybe. Hopefully.
notes: Keyword prints as UNIQUE IGNATIOUS (confirmed on an enlarged crop) while the type line says 'ignatius'. Seriously Weird Crystalline Artefact (019/140) prints UNIQUE IGNATIUS.

name: Meh, another Living God
subtitle: le sigh
rules: FLIP UP – 7 [O]
flavor:
bleh
I mean, what more is there to say about it?
notes: Flavor 'bleh' is printed in large italic type with the small italic line under it.

name: Night-basking Basilisk
subtitle: petrifying quietus of the dark
rules: COVERT -- EXTRA COST – If you control [O][O][O][O][O][O], reduce the numeric cost of this card by 4.
flavor: I am the terror that craps in the night.

name: Obsession
printing: alternate art: plain pale background with a large faded Obsession eye
notes: Card is printed sideways. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number. Footer: 'Art: TGA www.thespoils.com'.

name: Obsession
printing: alternate art: pale background covered in purple splatters
notes: Card is printed sideways. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number. Footer: 'Art: TGA www.thespoils.com'.

name: Obsession
printing: alternate art: plain white background with a single purple splatter
notes: Card is printed sideways. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number. Footer: 'Art: TGA www.thespoils.com'.

name: Obsessive Concentration
rules: This resource may only be played from your hand face down. -- PROVIDES – [O] -- FLIP IT – [O] -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Put this card into play face-up. Draw 3 cards. If you do, put 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
notes: Card is printed sideways. Card prints 'face down' where catalog has 'face-down' (trivial).

name: Offering of False Friendship
subtitle: enjoy your beads!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Any opponent may pay 2. If they do, terminate this card. Otherwise, put that character and characters with the same name as that character on the bottom of their owner's deck.
flavor: You can't fake sincerity - you have to make it up on the spot.

name: Predatory Lamp
subtitle: gotcha!
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, you may pick a character with COVERT. If you do, that character loses COVERT while this card is in play.
flavor:
Bringing light to where the sun don't shine in all kinds of nasty ways.
I should have been sad when the lamp went out, but instead I was delighted.
notes: The second flavor paragraph is a pun printed in tiny italic type under a divider. Footer also credits 'Original Open R&D Concept by boxing_clever'.

name: Profane Proposal
subtitle: everybody needs a retirement plan
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick an opponent. -- Search your deck for 5 cards with different names and reveal them. That player separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and shuffle the other into your deck.
flavor: "... and this my friends, is how we obtain ultimate voidal power."

name: Puerile Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: kid's play
rules: When this card enters play you may pick a non-resource card. If you do, put a token on the card.
flavor:
Thirty days in the dungeon! Everyone in this room! Mmmlluuuuuuugh!
It wasn't school he disliked - it was just the principal of it.
notes: The second flavor paragraph is a pun printed in tiny italic type under a divider.

name: Seance Sensor
subtitle: found in the archives of the forbidden bibliotheca...
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- SEIZE -- COST – Remove a token from this card. Deplete this card. Pick a player. -- EFFECT – That player discards a card. -- ABSORB HUMOUR -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card.

name: Seriously Weird Crystalline Artefact
subtitle: ...this strange item obviously houses great power...
rules: RECYCLE JUNK -- COST – Pay 3. Pick a non-resource card in your discard pile and remove it from the game. X is the numeric cost of the card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card with the same type as the picked card and numeric cost X or less. Put it into your discard pile. Draw a card. -- SERAPHIM FUSION -- COST – Pay 4. Pick a UNIQUE IGNATIUS you control. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "Uhluhtc Niudla" and put it into play.
notes: SERAPHIM FUSION cost prints the keyword as 'UNIQUE IGNATIUS' (confirmed on an enlarged crop); catalog says 'UNIQUE IGNATIOUS', which is how Ignatius Gloamspike (010/140) prints its keyword. The two cards disagree on spelling on paper, so as printed this pick would not match Gloamspike's keyword. Everything else matches the catalog.

name: Serpentine Scepter
subtitle: ...that can change the course of lugubria's future
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- SOUL DRAIN -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Deplete the attached character. -- SOUL CHARGE -- COST – Use this ability only once each turn. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Restore the attached character. It cannot attack this turn.

name: Thabbashite Barbeque
subtitle: you want a burger or a weenie? ...uhhhh
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- Any opponent may pay 2. If they do, put this card into its owner's hand and terminate it. Otherwise, put the picked card into its owner's hand. Look at an opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. That player discards the card.
flavor: The expedition grew silent when it was announced the Thabbashites would be serving finger foods.

name: Thabbashite Communicant
subtitle: pierced peace
rules: When a card that provides at least [V] enters play under your control, you may look at the top card of your deck. If you do, you may put it on the bottom.
flavor: The women of the Muelon tribe believe that heart's blood, properly prepared and served, satiates the living gods. There are notable risks involved in the feeding, primarily, being eaten.

name: Thabbashite Temple
subtitle: anything but inconspicious
rules: CALL UPON THE GODS -- COST – Deplete this card. X is the number of [V] you control. Pay 10-X. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a character with numeric cost X or less and put it into play depleted. -- VOLATE -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a face-up resource you control. -- EFFECT – Flip that resource face-down under its owner's control.
notes: Subtitle is printed 'inconspicious' (sic), confirmed on an enlarged crop.

name: Uhluhtc Niudla
subtitle: ph'nglui mglw'nafh uhluhtc r'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn
rules: UNIQUE UHLUHTC -- PREVAIL UPON -- COST – Put a resource you control into its owner's hand. Pick a player. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – That player puts a face-down resource they control into its owner's hand. -- AVAIL ANEW -- COST – Reveal a resource from your hand and shuffle it into your deck. Pay 1. -- EFFECT – If the revealed card was named "Obsession", this card gains COVERT this turn. Draw a card.

name: Vexing Nullifier
subtitle: viciously vexing the vivacious
rules: If this character would inflict battle damage to a character, put that character into its owner's hand instead. -- If a character would inflict battle damage to this character, put this character into its owner's hand instead.

name: Voidal Humour Redistribution
subtitle: top men toiling away
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Remove X tokens from cards you control. -- Put X tokens divided however you want on any non-resource cards. Draw a card.
flavor: One day, unless we find ourselves a source, Voidal Humour may run out. That's where the god comes in.

name: Will of a Living God
subtitle: to some a blessing, to others a curse
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- (put this card into play attached to that character instead of into its owner's discard pile) -- This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- The attached character gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on this card. -- At the start of your turn, remove a token from this card. If you cannot, destroy the attached character.
notes: Footer also credits 'Original Open R&D Concept by lillebror'.

name: Abecedarian Investor
subtitle: he's got you covered
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick a card. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a card as part of its cost, remove a token from the card.
flavor: There's a reason he's smiling. Look it up.

name: Addlebrained Defense Attorney
subtitle: he'll have your brains on a platter
flavor: I concur and move to strike. Or both! HAHA! I don't know nothin' about how I do anything.
notes: Card has no rules text, only flavor.

name: Akashic Coin
subtitle: mystic moola
rules: UNIQUE AKASHIC OBJECT -- When a card that provides at least [V] enters play under an opponent's control, that player may pay 2. If they don't, you may have your faction lose 1 influence. If you do, draw a card. Otherwise, flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
flavor: Spiritualists of Thabbash have been known to harness the void to create fake currency using akashic coins. It is always a good idea to have a way to test money you get from a Thabbashite.

name: Asbestos Drywall
subtitle: you said you wanted drywall, right?
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a location. -- Remove 2 damage markers from the location or add 2 damage markers to the location. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G][G]
flavor: Well, it's drywall.
notes: Card prints 'from the location or add 2 damage markers to the location'; catalog says 'the card'. The picked card is a location, so it plays the same.

name: Canny Bailiff
subtitle: you didn't see nothing
rules: While an opponent is deploying a tactic, its numeric cost is increased to a minimum of 3.
flavor: So what if he didn't do it? Everyone's guilty of something.

name: Cathédrale de Mau
subtitle: money is god, greed is king, and corruption runs the rest
rules: UNIQUE CATHEDRAL -- When damage is inflicted to a location you control, you may reduce the amount by 1. If you do, your faction loses 1 influence. -- When damage is inflicted to a character you control with numeric cost 6 or greater, you may reduce the amount by 1. If you do, your faction loses 1 influence.

name: Crematory Cache
subtitle: ash to ash, dust to -- SHINY!
rules: When a character is destroyed, you may gain 1 influence.
flavor: Honoring the dead by enriching the living.

name: Deceitful Mortgage Underwriter
subtitle: no cash, no credit, no problem
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- EXTRA INTEREST -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Put a damage marker on the location. -- FLIP UP – 4 [G][G][G]
notes: Card prints 'Put a damage marker on the location'; catalog says 'on the card'. The picked card is a location, so it plays the same.

name: Defalcating Accountant
subtitle: skimming off the top
rules: When this card restores, you may draw a card.
flavor: Fiduciary capacity maldoer. Fervent cash manipulator. Furry cat man. Falsifying clerk of misappropriation.

name: Early Investment
subtitle: i think this will be a great money relationship
rules: Search your deck for a resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.
flavor: If we're going to make this journey, we'll need money. And lots of it.

name: Espionage Loafers
subtitle: made from the softest of furs... and dead bunnies
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains COVERT. If the attached card inflicts damage to a faction, inflict that much damage to your faction. -- [G][G][G][G][G] – The attached character gains COVERT and this card loses all other rules text.

name: Expedition Advisor
subtitle: worth every penny
rules: When this card enters play, you may draw 2 cards then discard 2 cards. -- RECUR – [G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Draw 2 cards then discard 2 cards.
flavor: I thought you said he was an intern.
